terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.usingBody: By opening this mini app you agree to these terms.
terms.whatBody: Finper lists bond names, prices, yields, months to maturity, and a risk mark. It does not place orders and it does not connect to a brokerage account.
terms.adviceBody: Prices and yields can be delayed or wrong. Nothing here is a recommendation to buy or sell.
terms.liabilityBody: You are responsible for decisions you make from these figures. Finper is not liable for losses, for errors in the quotes, or for what happens on T-Bank after you leave.
terms.changesBody: If these terms change, the date on this page changes with them.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: Finper is a Telegram mini app that lists bond quotes. It does not ask you to sign in and it does not take a brokerage token.
privacy.onThisPhoneBody: Your filter choices — risk, months to maturity, and sort — are saved in this browser so they are still here after you leave. Clearing this site's data removes them. The app does not build a profile of you.
privacy.openBondBody: A row opens that bond on T-Bank. What you do there is covered by T-Bank, not by this policy.
